window.comment: 30 frames @5fps = 6s windows, 1s stride. Built within a single segment only -> never crosses a cut or half-time.

smoothing.comment: Savitzky-Golay on velocity, per slot per segment, at detection fps before downsampling. Never spans a cut.

possession.comment: Ball possession = nearest player within this radius of the ball; flagged per frame on that player's row.

validation.comment: GSR: last fraction of clips. Metrica: last fraction of each segment's timeline (windows crossing the boundary are dropped, so train and val never share a frame).

style_chunk_comment: Metrica only: per-team style knobs are computed per 60s chunk (not per match) so FiLM conditioning sees many diverse style samples.
